disclaimer.title: Before you use the Drug Reference
disclaimer.intro: This tool shows general health information from official <s>drug labels</s> (AEMPS in Spanish, FDA in English) and matches symptoms to over-the-counter options. It is provided for <s>information only</s>.
disclaimer.b1: It is <s>not medical advice</s> and not a substitute for a doctor, pharmacist, or nurse.
disclaimer.b2: It is <s>not a drug-interaction checker</s>. Always read each product’s full label and check with a professional before combining medicines.
disclaimer.b3: Situation matches come from label text, not clinical recommendations — they can be incomplete or include products you wouldn’t expect.
disclaimer.b4: Always follow the directions on the <s>actual product you have</s>; dosages and warnings differ between products.
disclaimer.b5: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe, worsening, or you’re unsure, <s>contact a medical professional or call emergency services</s>.
disclaimer.data: Data is from openFDA (U.S. FDA, public domain). NOMAD is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FDA.

compare.disclaimer: <s>This shows each drug's own FDA-labeled interaction warnings, individually.</s> It is <s>not</s> a cross-drug interaction checker and is <s>not</s> a substitute for professional medical review. Absence of text here does not mean a drug is safe to combine.

safety.title: Informational reference only — not medical advice.
safety.b1: These results match FDA drug-label indications to a situation. They are <s>not a recommendation</s> and <s>not an FDA endorsement</s>.
safety.b2: This is <s>not a drug-interaction checker</s>. Read each label’s full warnings, and check with a pharmacist or clinician before combining medicines.
safety.b3: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe or worsening, <s>contact a medical professional or call emergency services</s>.
safety.b1Aemps: These results match the indications in AEMPS (Spain) leaflets to a situation. <s>They are not a recommendation</s> or <s>an AEMPS endorsement</s>. They are non-prescription medicines authorized in Spain; in your country they may have another name or need a prescription.

remedyNote.title: Informational only — not medical advice.
remedyNote.body: These remedies have limited or mixed evidence, are not FDA-evaluated, and are not a substitute for professional care. Check with a clinician before using any of them, and before combining one with a medication you already take.
remedyNote.emergency: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe or worsening, <s>seek real medical care — call emergency services</s>.

ingest.dlFailed: The download failed — it retries automatically; if it stays failed, press "Download FDA data" to restart. Finished parts are kept and resume where they left off.
ingest.dlDone: All parts are on disk. Indexing them into search next.
ingest.dlRunning: Pulling part {{n}} of {{total}} — ~1.7 GB total across all parts.
ingest.inFailed: Indexing failed — press "Ingest into search" to retry from the downloaded files (no re-download). Already-indexed labels are kept (the refresh is idempotent).
ingest.inRunning: Writing part {{n}} of {{total}} into the offline database.
ingest.inWriting: Writing labels into the offline database.
ingest.background: Runs in the background — you can leave this page and it keeps going. Search turns on automatically when ingest finishes.

show.interactionsNote: Single-drug label information — not a cross-drug interaction checker
show.unvalidated: Do not rely on this data to make decisions regarding medical care. While every effort is made to ensure accuracy, you should assume all results are unvalidated.

cond.matchesNote: Matches are FDA label-indication text, not medical recommendations. Do not rely on this data to make decisions regarding medical care.

asIs: Label data is provided as-is; do not rely on it for medical decisions.
